units.source_text: 忽然，耳边响起了咳嗽声。

en.t: Suddenly, the sound of coughing rang out beside his ear.

units.source_text: 不知什么时候，一个乡里渔夫似的老头，紧挨着他站在那里。

en.t: Without his noticing when, an old man who looked like a village fisherman was standing there close beside him.

units.source_text: 老头的眼睛一会儿瞧瞧照相机，一会儿瞄瞄洞穴底，没磨光的兔子皮似的脸上满是皱纹，堆起笑容。

en.t: The old man's eyes darted now to the camera, now to the bottom of the pit, and his face, wrinkled all over like an unpolished rabbit pelt, gathered into a smile.

units.source_text: 眼睛充血，眼角上堆着厚厚一层眼屎。

en.t: His eyes were bloodshot, and a thick layer of sleep had crusted at their corners.
